summary: American Honda Receivables LLC, as depositor, filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for Honda Auto Receivables 2026-4 Owner Trust, a $2,105,270,000 auto-loan ABS transaction (offered amount $2.0 billion). Five note classes price at par-ish with coupons 4.303% (A-1), 4.72% (A-2a), SOFR+0.36% (A-2b), 5.02% (A-3) and 5.11% (A-4); final stated dates 2027-2033. Credit enhancement is excess interest, certificate subordination, reserve fund and yield supplement account; AHFC retains at least 5% of each class. J.P. Morgan, Deutsche Bank, ING and TD are joint bookrunners; settlement is on or about 2026-11-12, with monthly payments from 2026-12-21. This is routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation.
